name: print-soc
description: Help agents configure NUS SoC printing, choose printers and track authorized jobs.

interface.shortDescription: Set up SoC printing, choose printers and track jobs.
interface.longDescription: Use the print-soc skill with the CLI, desktop and MCP to configure system printing, find accessible queues, prepare documents and settings, and track authorized print jobs.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the print-soc skill to set up SoC printing, find an accessible printer and prepare my document and settings before printing.
